opencode_pool.note: 2026-10-16: shared pool across all models. Go calibrated against user dashboard (82% 5h, 90% week) and local spend ($9.70/$26.46). Go Plus is an unverified 4x estimate.

dashboard.note: User's OpenCode Go dashboard reading after the weekly reset and new API key. Update with each new reading; hx uses it until each window rolls past it.

routing_balance.note: 2026-11-06 creator correction: leverage Devin and OpenCode equally while free SWE-2 lasts (Devin is free this month and disappears next month). Both idle -> the worker with fewer decision lines in the recent .hx/routing.jsonl wins, so over a day the split is about 50/50; one busy or unavailable -> the other. After until, OpenCode on the ladder (deepseek-v4.1-flash first) is the default and Devin is not routed.

thresholds.pool_soft_limit_note: 2026-10-17 owner directive: spend all OpenCode allowance before falling back to Codex (was 0.85); 0.98 keeps a margin because spend is estimated.

say.work_ttl_note: Ordinary worker briefs expire one day after creation when hx say gets no --ttl. Lead reports are durable and never expire through this guard.

ladders_note: 2026-10-22 owner directive, temporary: glm-5.3-flash demoted to last in every ladder and replaced as the persistent model after repeated stalls and a context overrun in real work (portfolio project); revisit after the next benchmark. 2026-11-06 creator executive decision: deepseek-v4.1-flash is the go-to model, first in every ladder and the persistent OpenCode model (Global regions enabled; smoke test passed).
opencode_variants_note: Declared --variant choices per model from opencode models --verbose (2026-10-16). glm-5.3-flash ignores an effort that is not one of these; route/ocrun must not send it.

excluded_models.deepseek-v4-pro: untested; Global regions are now enabled (2026-11-06), benchmark before use
excluded_models.minimax-m3: Exhausts its fixed 32K reasoning budget with ~no output on multi-file edits after ~35K context: 4 of 6 real tasks on 2026-10-16 (docs/FINDINGS.md 7, 9). No variants to lower it.

context_limits_note: Effective worker limits for compaction decisions, capped at 200K: every call re-sends the context as cached input, so cost pressure arrives long before the native window (opencode models --verbose, 2026-10-16: 1M for most, 262144 for kimi-k2.7-code). DeepSeek v4.1 Flash native context is 1000000 per OpenCode models.json opencode-go metadata (models.dev, verified 2026-11-08); its effective budget follows the same 200K cap. gpt-6.1-sol native context is 475000 measured in the live usage event model_context_window (docs/audit/codex.md:52; a cached record read 500000). The swe-2 ids show a 262144 denominator on the dev-devin pane footer (docs/audit/devin.md:67). Both take the same 200K effective cap.

context.reset_grace_note: A recorded reset clears worker pressure holds until the provider has a new session, for at most this long. The new session appears on the pane's first message, so hx say may carry that message. After the window an unchanged session is treated as a fake reset.
context.claude_lead_note: Compact at 0.6 of the context window the statusline reports, so a 1M lead compacts near 600K. The 400K context_limits entry is only the fallback when the statusline has no positive context_window_size.

promo.source: https://docs.devin.ai/desktop/models: 'SWE-2 is free for self-serve plans in Devin Desktop and Devin CLI through November 30, 2026; it does not apply to Devin cloud sessions.' devin models list tags swe-2-medium/high/max cost_tier Free (Devin Pro, CLI 3000.11.234).
promo.note: No timezone is published, so free routing ends at the end of 30 Nov in UTC+14 (the earliest reading). After that, or if the live model list stops tagging the model Free, hx refuses Devin runs. Extending ends_at needs renewed pricing verification and the user's approval.

devin.note: 2026-11-06 creator correction: leverage free Devin SWE-2 and OpenCode equally while the promotion lasts, then OpenCode with deepseek-v4.1-flash first is the default and Devin is not routed. routing_balance holds the rule; Lightning variants are paid and never allowed. models maps hx effort to a SWE-2 id: high by default, max for hard work; dispatch swe-2-medium by hand when latency matters.
devin.max_concurrent_note: 2026-10-31: two concurrent runs measured (separate repos, both ok on swe-2-high, no throttling); a third was refused busy. Raise only after measuring; parallel runs still need disjoint files or worktrees.
devin.compact_note: 2026-11-09 live-verified on the worker pane: /compact drops the footer 63% to 7% and keeps the session's brief; it needs a second Enter when the command menu stages it, which hx send_slash now handles. /compact is the recovery command for every provider; /clear stays a manual reset through context.reset_commands.

research.note: read-only plus web: the report is the final message; writes are refused

review.note: read-only code review; may run the test suite

implement.note: writes in its worktree, runs tests, owns its branch; never commit, push, reset or clone

release.note: lead only: workers are never launched with this profile

profiles_note: C5 named execution profiles: deny lists are self-contained Exec rules matched like the static deny list; allow rules carve out of deny (checked first). write_roots scopes Write() path checks; 'cwd' resolves to the run directory.
